user.title: Add Tuya Account
user.description: Choose the cloud channel. Smart Life uses the same QR-code login as the native Tuya integration (no quota, realtime push, camera video). Tuya IoT OpenAPI uses the Access ID/Secret of an iot.tuya.com project.

menu_options.smartlife: Smart Life / Tuya Smart (QR Code) — recommended

openapi.title: Add Tuya IoT Account
openapi.description: Validates your Tuya Cloud OpenAPI credentials and fetches the full catalog (including local_key and scenes). No device or scene entities are created yet: after adding the account, click Configure on the account entry to choose which devices and scenes are added to Home Assistant.

data.client_id: Access ID / Client ID (Tuya IoT Core)

smartlife.title: Smart Life Account
smartlife.description: In the Smart Life or Tuya Smart app: Me → Settings → Account and Security → User Code. Paste it below. {msg}

smartlife_scan.title: Scan the QR Code
smartlife_scan.description: Open the Smart Life/Tuya Smart app → scan icon (top right) → scan the code and confirm the login in the app. Then press Submit. {msg}
